questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Which structure in the nucleus contains the genetic code for a specific protein?
questions.explanation: A gene is a segment of DNA that codes for a specific polypeptide/protein.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 1.2

Name the nitrogenous base that pairs with adenine in DNA.
questions.explanation: In DNA, adenine pairs with thymine (A–T).
